title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1651: Emperor yus court (3)

section.p: The various parties were in discussion about the new developments.
Su Yu might be a nominal leader without much actual power over humanity, but this was still a matter to be taken seriously.
At the same time.
Celestial chasm race.

The Celestial Chasm Realm was a realm constantly shrouded in darkness. The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor had just sent the South Chamber head out of his dark palace. The Heavenly Overseer Marquis was trying to buy the visual character from him. The marquis must be dreaming.

He stared at a fragment in his hand. Above the fragment, a visual character could be seen. When he focused on the fragment, he could see the images of numerous geniuses and experts from the various races. After a while, a certain figure emerged from the fragment. But soon, it faded.

The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor frowned and ignored the figure. Before long, he summoned another figure, a figure resembling Xia Longwu. After a slight hesitation, he produced a drop of black blood at the tip of his finger and pointed at the figure.
Instantly, a saber emerged.
The drop of blood was reduced to nothingness.
“Is his willpower so powerful?” The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor sighed regretfully and muttered, “What a pity that I can’t summon Su Yu through this fragment…”
After a while, he put the matter aside and said, “Come.”
Shortly after, someone covered in dark robes entered the room and said, “Emperor.”
“Has the death tunnel opened?”
“No.”

After a short silence, the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor said, “Lure some death sovereigns over. The South Chamber head is here on behalf of the Heavenly Overseer Marquis. They are trying to buy the fragment in my hand. I’m worried that they will try something drastic after failing.”
“Emperor, not even Heavenly Overseer Marquis himself can survive entering the Celestial Chasm Realm.”

The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor nodded in agreement. With the suppressive force, the Heavenly Overseer Marquis would not be his match unless the marquis had the ability to break the realm itself. However, the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor still felt uneasy.
After thinking for a bit, he said, “Just make more preparations as a precaution.”
“Yes!”
The person in dark robes withdrew from the room.
The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor continued muttering to himself, “I don’t fear the Heavenly Overseer Marquis, but the humans…they are free of the suppressive force!”

He hesitated slightly before taking a dark ball out. After taking another glance at the fragment, he tossed the dark ball into it. Before long, dark smoke emerged from the fragment. Then, an illusory figure with a blank expression emerged from the fragment.

With a smile, the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor said, “Since you’re still around, your master must still be alive. Sure enough, Fiery Sea is not that man. I knew it. Fiery Sea is too stupid to be that man.”
The figure shook slightly as some clarity appeared in its eyes. After a long while, the figure spoke with great difficulty, “Occupied…speak fast…no time…”
“Inform your master that I need to know the recent updates in the Human Realm. Pay extra attention to Great Qin King, Great Zhou King, Great Xia King, and Great Ming King.”
“My master…does not answer to you!”
The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor said, “Your master might have forgotten that you’re still under my control. Since I can find you, it’s only a matter of time before I discover your master.”
The figure sneered and said, “I am merely a dog of my master…I can die through self-detonation at any time. What can you…do through me?”

The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor sank into silence. After a while, he said, “Get him to help me. I will repay him. I can kill one person for him. The promise of a Daofuse is very valuable. Didn’t I help him with Ye Batian back then?”
After a short pause, the figure replied, “I will pass the message.”
“Good.”
The figure faded away.
The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor started rapping on his armrest. Why…was he still feeling uneasy?
Who could kill him when he was hiding in his realm?
Nobody!
Not Grand Dream. Not Tiangu. All would be suppressed upon entering the Celestial Chasm Realm.
“Is it the Heavenly Overseer Marquis?”

The marquis might have lost patience after learning about the visual character. Unfortunately, that was something the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor would never give up on. In fact, the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor even wanted the entire Heavenly Hunt Index for himself.
Alas, the Heavenly Overseer Marquis was too strong.
Meanwhile, Su Yu was still waiting for his formation to be completed.
He did not have much time left.
According to Great Zhou King, they would leave tomorrow. Heavenly Seal King might not return from the trip alive. Who could help him with the formation without Heavenly Seal King?

Su Yu wasn’t worried that Heavenly Seal King or Silk Destroying King would leave some backdoors in his formation. After all, Great Ming King was the person truly in charge of the process. They wouldn’t risk exposure by doing such an unnecessary action.
The real traitor would not do something like that. Furthermore, Great Zhou King and Great Xia King were right beside them.

Slowly, the sky turned dark. At daybreak, Su Yu would need to set off toward Nanyuan, while Great Zhou King and the others would need to leave for their mission. They would all be replaced by some character clones, and Su Yu would provide cover for them.

Great Zhou King intended to take only Xia Longwu, Heavenly Seal King, Silk Destroying King, and a few others away. Would Heavenly Seal King suspect anything? How was he supposed to traverse through the Allheaven Battlefield undetected with so many people? Would they require the guardians to help cover for them as well?
The Celestial Chasm Realm is very far away, and it was near the Divine Realm. Any carelessness would ruin everything. They could end up trapped in the Celestial Chasm Realm.
While Su Yu was deep in thought, a Sunmoon arrived.
The Sunmoon looked nervous facing so many top experts. He bowed slightly at the various Invincibles. Noticing his arrival, the Heavenly Seal King frowned slightly and asked, “What is it?”
“Lord, the second and ninth young masters started fighting due to a small matter during cultivation. They are still fighting right now. This old servant can’t do anything to them. Lord…”

“Ridiculous!” Heavenly Seal King frowned and said, “I understand. Go and suppress them with force. Tell them you’re doing this on my order. If they keep causing trouble, threaten further punishment from me.”
“Yes, Lord.”
The Sunmoon left.

Beside Su Yu, Great Zhou King smiled and said, “Curious who that was? A servant Heavenly Seal took in back then. The second and ninth young masters are the students of Heavenly Seal. Both are very talented, and both are very competitive toward each other. We all know about their frequent quarrels.”
Su Yu nodded with a smile and said, “A seventh-stage Sunmoon? Not bad.”

“Yeah. Back then, that servant was also someone on the Heavenly Hunt Index. Eventually, he was saved by Heavenly Seal after suffering a serious injury. Since then, he has served as Heavenly Seal’s servant to repay the favor. These years, he has been handling all sorts of trivial matters for Heavenly Seal.”
Once again, Su Yu nodded. Heavenly Seal King said nothing. He was still focused on the formation.
While yawning, Su Yu said, “That reminds me. Majesties, remember to register even your servants and suicide soldiers at the Mountainsea Realm and above.”
Great Zhou King laughed and asked, “Are you sure?”

“Of course.” Su Yu glanced at the recently departed servant of Heavenly Seal King and said, “As for that guy, death seems near for him. He’s even starting to produce a small amount of death qi. That must be due to his age and his past injuries. What a pity.”
“Death qi?”
Great Zhou King had a thoughtful look while Su Yu remained completely nonchalant. He was essentially an expert in death qi.

Nobody could hide death qi from him. There was no need to compare the living against him. Even the dead would not be as sensitive to death qi since they were already too used to death qi. Only Su Yu, someone both dead and alive, would be so sensitive toward death qi.
Great Zhou King nodded, “Yes. He is indeed quite old.”

Su Yu smiled. Good. He only needed Great Zhou King to take note of that servant as well. After all, the servant had arrived out of nowhere. There might be a trick at play here. However, Su Yu couldn’t be bothered to do more. With Great Zhou King personally handling the matter, he wasn’t too worried.
The contents of the servant’s conversation with Heavenly Seal king sounded normal, but that in itself was suspicious. Was it worth bothering Heavenly Seal King for such a small matter?

Second young master and ninth young master? A seventh-stage Sunmoon like the old servant could easily solve this issue. Of course, there was also the possibility that the old servant did not dare to do anything due to their identities.
Great Zhou King asked, “Have you thought of a name for the new holy land?”
Su Yu smiled and said, “Yes. Emperor Yu’s Court. To commemorate Human Emperor Xing Yu.”
Was he being serious?
Great Zhou King was stunned. Great Xia King and the others looked at him with stupefaction as well. Was he serious?

Su Yu said nonchalantly, “This is a holy land of humanity. It is normal that we use this chance to commemorate the ancient Human Emperor. With the Luminous Domain (Xing Yu) Mansion around, I don’t know if that was his dao title or his name. But it doesn’t matter. To avoid clashing against the name of the Luminous Domain Mansion, we’ll call our holy land Emperor Yu’s Court.”
Just how shameless was this guy?
All the Invincibles were stunned.
He was too shameless!
Was he really using that name to commemorate the ancient Human Emperor? Be honest!
Even Great Zhou King couldn’t take it anymore. He coughed and said, “That name is too… attention-grabbing. Too much attention isn’t healthy for one’s lifespan.”

Su Yu laughed and said, “Emperor Yu. The Emperor of the starry cosmos (also Xing Yu), also the Emperor of humanity, the conqueror of the Myriad Realms. Is someone like that not worth commemorating? Are you saying that we should forget the glory of the ancient past?”
The Invincibles had nothing to say.
Everyone knew what the kid was trying to do here. He was too shameless!
Commemorating the Human Emperor? Bullshit!
Nobody would buy that!
Su Yu yawned and said, “We’ve decided, then. If you disagree, we can also name it Emperor Yu’s Heaven. Yes. Heaven sounds better than court. I don’t mind. We can change the name if you want.”
Was the word court the issue here?
No! Emperor Yu was the issue here!
Great Xia King asked, “Why don’t you name it Emperor Su’s Court instead?”

Su Yu laughed and said, “That’s too straightforward. I’m shy. Emperor Yu is better. I’m doing this for the ancient Human Emperor, not myself. If you want, you can call me Holy Lord Emperor Yu in the future. If that’s too long, just call me Emperor Yu for short.”
The Invincibles were left completely speechless.
What could they do if someone could be shameless to this extent?
Emperor Yu?
Was this kid not afraid of shortening his lifespan?
An Emperor…was not a title to be easily taken.
Not even those Daofuses had the courage to call themselves Emperors.
Not even the Hundred Battle King dared to call himself an Emperor back during the ninth epoch.
Su Yu was getting too full of himself!
After a long silence, Great Zhou King said, “That’s an ambitious name. But…I’m scared for what would happen if the ancient past were to return.”

Su Yu narrowed his eyes and said, “It’s fine. A good elder will not cause trouble for their juniors about such a trivial matter. Only a bad elder will do so. And a bad elder…is unqualified to remain human. Anyone not a human…can simply die.”
Such a perfect argument.
Great Zhou King was rendered completely speechless. He decided to shut his mouth.
